name: vermax
description: Vermax - NSE swing-trading decision platform (NestJS API + Python ML + React UI)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run start:dev -w api" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w api && npm run build -w web
scripts.ml:research: cd ml && python -m vermax.run_features && python -m vermax.xsection
